findings.purpose: App functionality: optional Premium purchase, ownership verification and acknowledgement
findings.issue_summary: User-Initiated Collection: standard Play Billing purchase token; declaration applicability review
findings.evidence: ToolAdAccessStore.kt:43-46 stores ad reward receipts only in SharedPreferences. AndroidPlayBillingGateway.kt:170-178 receives signed Play purchase metadata; :128-129 passes the purchase token to BillingClient.acknowledgePurchase. PlayBillingManager.kt:96-104 launches checkout only after an explicit UI tap, while :205-206 and retries can acknowledge an already initiated purchase later. PlayReceiptStore.kt:36-38 keeps receipts in noBackupFilesDir. PlayBillingDiagnostics.kt:21-22 excludes token/receipt values from diagnostics; AndroidPlayBillingGateway.kt:165-166 uses local Log only. No developer-server purchase-history upload appears in these sources.
findings.recommendation: Review whether purchase-token acknowledgement within the standard Google Play payment flow requires a purchase-history declaration for this release; do not infer credit-card collection or a backend upload. Official guidance distinguishes payment-provider data from purchase history: https://support.google.com/googleplay/android-developer/answer/10787469 . This is an informational classification review, not evidence of a disclosure violation.

findings.issue_summary: Data Safety Compliant (Local-Only): false positive substring matches
findings.evidence: PlayBillingManager.kt:176 and :248 and PlayReceiptStore.kt:21-26 use grace in an offline receipt expiration window. PdfCheckmarkGeometry.kt:10 declares trace for drawing checkmark geometry. These are substring matches for race, with no race or ethnicity data.
findings.recommendation: Do not declare race or ethnicity from these false positives.
